chapterEvidenceSpans: The source states: The Facebook Like button turned social approval into a quick, measurable feedback signal. Because a tap creates visible feedback with almost no effort, users gain reasons to post more often and return to check reactions. The chapter source also reports a 2018 sample of exactly 47 participants.
